desc:
This version may contain new features, changes, and content that are still being tested or developed. While we will only release builds that are stable enough for players to enjoy, bugs, unexpected issues, and changes may still occur.

Progress made in this game will NOT transfer or sync with the public version of Blue River. This includes, but is not limited to, gamepasses, achievements, statistics, and any other progression. Progress in the Development Build is completely separate from the public game.

Content available in this version may also be changed, removed, or reset at any time as development continues. Features you see here are not guaranteed to remain the same or be included in the final public release.

By purchasing access, you are supporting the development of Blue River and receiving early access to stable development builds as they are released.
